lesson.grammar_point: verb to be (I am, you are, he/she/it is: affirmative, negative and questions)

listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome to the International Auto Parts Fair in Frankfurt. The fair is open from nine a.m. to six p.m. Hall three is for brakes and tires. Hall five is for paint and tools. The restaurant is on the first floor. Please have your visitor badge with you. It is free for all visitors. Enjoy the fair!

Hi, my name is Rafael. I am from Brazil, and I am thirty-five years old. I am a mechanic, and I am also a business owner. My repair shop is in Curitiba. It is not big, but it is busy. Today I am at a fair in Germany. I am a little nervous, but the people here are very friendly. My English is simple, and that is okay.

extra_audio.text: Camillo is at an auto parts fair in Frankfurt. He is at a German brand's booth. A woman says: Hi, I am Laura. He says: I am Camillo, and I am from Brazil. He is a business owner with three repair shops. They are happy, and he gives Laura his business card.
